mapper.select: select top 1 count(1) as cnt from ${msg_table} where STATUS = '0' and isnull(REQUEST_TIME, getdate()) <= getdate() and UMID is null and MSG_TYPE in ( '6' )
mapper.update: update ${msg_table} set STATUS = '9' ,UMID = '${group_no}' where CMID in (select top 1000 r.CMID from ${msg_table} r where STATUS = '0' and isnull(REQUEST_TIME, getdate()) <= getdate() and UMID is null and MSG_TYPE in ( '6' ) )
update ${msg_table} set status = '1', send_time = getdate() where status = '9' and UMID = '${group_no}' and MSG_TYPE in ( '6')
update ${msg_table} set status = '0', UMID = null, send_time = null where status = '9' and UMID = '${group_no}' and MSG_TYPE in ( '6')
mapper.select: select CMID as msg_seq ,'AT' as messagetype ,MSG_BODY as msg_txt ,RE_BODY as sms_txt ,concat('82', replace(SUBSTRING(DEST_PHONE, 2, 15),'-','')) as call_to ,SEND_PHONE as call_from ,(case when RE_TYPE is null then null when RE_TYPE = 'SMS' then 'S' when RE_TYPE = 'MMS' then 'L' when RE_TYPE = 'LMS' then 'L' end) as smskind ,SUBJECT as msg_txt_title ,'D' as pcom ,CINFO as userdata ,'N' as crypto ,format(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as curr_date ,BUTTON1 as btn_1 ,null as btn_2 ,null as btn_3 ,null as btn_4 ,null as btn_5 ,TEMPLATE_CODE as template_cd ,(case when SENDER_KEY = 'dea7b987570b486753ad25dc339934b6617f4b55' then '422516f374c0960c1e25f30ac7182a84db0669e4' else SENDER_KEY end) as profile_key ,(case when REQUEST_TIME is not null then format(REQUEST_TIME,'yyyyMMddHHmmss') else '00000000000000' end ) as snd_dttm from ${msg_table} where STATUS = '9' and UMID = '${group_no}' and MSG_TYPE in ( '6' )
mapper.insert: update ${msg_table} set STATUS = '${sms_st}' ,CALL_STATUS = '${rslt_val}' ,REPORT_TIME = convert(DATETIME, '${cmp_rcv_dttm}') ,TEL_INFO = '${rcv_mno_cd}' where CMID = '${cmid}'
insert into ${log_table} select * from ${msg_table} where CMID = '${cmid}'
